title: Webアプリケーション
subtitle: Web Application
educationalGoal: The primary purpose of this course is to assist students in understanding the development concepts and environments of Web application, and to master the skills needed when administrating Web applications on three-tier system databases. In particular, students will learn database construction and how to make connections between Web applications and their newly constructed databases. Students will also be given the opportunity try to create a Web service that contributes to regional contents like “Cool Kanazawa”.
advice: In this course, students will learn about creating network access to a three-tier model database based on their acquired knowledge of networks, security, and Web programming. The first half of the course consists of lectures based on Chapters 1 to 8 of the assigned textbook and practice involving sample programs. In second half of the course, students will learn about model view controllers (MVCs) and develop Web applications through practice with the device. In the end of the course, students will submit their developed Web applications as reports.
books: Textbooks:3ステップでしっかり学ぶMySQL入門 改訂第3版[技術評論社] Reference books:基礎からのPHP [ソフトバンククリエイティブ] Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: An understanding of the “Database” and “Web programming” courses is necessary for this course. In particular, PHP programming skill is strongly desired, and programming skills for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript may also be helpful.
